cardinality.rule: dataId: if this is a view reference, a render plan layer, an event detail, an actor entry, a stack input or a projection request of Cornerstone, the key is displaySetId
getActiveDataId: never public: on a planar or an ECG viewport getSourceDisplaySetId() gives the same id, and the slide that a whole slide viewport shows has no public getter
getSourceDataId: its name in 6.0 is getSourceDisplaySetId
